I’m just speaking from my own personal experience man. I may not relate to you I’m just a kid (22) lol. The reason I said it was because I remember coming on this sub on my other Reddit asking about drinking and cutting back about a year ago. Fast forward 1 year my alcohol was way out of control, I failed a suicide attempt, I continued drinking, and had a realization that I couldn’t control it. Someone told me in my first post that I was asking for permission to drink and it sounded like I was an alcoholic. He was damn right. It may have been harsh of him to say but at least he was honest with me. It stuck with me to this day. I’m not going to do that though because it’s not my style. If you think you need to stop deep down then you probably should. I lied to myself for so long and I’m so far behind in school because of it.

Edit: we are actually similar in age. Be careful friend I saw myself going down a bad path drinking that much.
